name: apple
description: Control native macOS apps — Messages, Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Maps — via AppleScript through the apple-mcp server. 8 tools, no API keys needed.

interface.shortDescription: Control macOS Messages, Mail, Notes, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, and Maps via AppleScript.
interface.longDescription: Imagine your agent being able to interact with your Mac's native apps — sending Messages, drafting emails in Mail, creating Calendar events, jotting Notes, setting Reminders, looking up Contacts, and even using Maps — all through natural language. No API keys, no complicated setup: your agent works with the apps you already use every day. Just ask your agent to send a message, check your calendar, or find a contact, and it happens on your Mac, using your own data.
defaultPrompt: Check my latest emails and unread messages for me.
Help me find a contact and send them a quick message.
What's on my calendar today? Any upcoming reminders?
